# Unconditionally safe commands
ls
ls -la
ls  -la
ls ""
mkdir -p foo/bar
pwd
cd /tmp
tree -L 2
tree -a --dirsfirst
grep -r "TODO" .
grep "hello world" file.txt
grep "a\"b" file.txt
cat file.txt
less file.txt
less -N file.txt
more file.txt
head -n 10 file.txt
tail -f file.txt
wc -l file.txt
diff a.txt b.txt
sort file.txt
sort -nr file.txt
sort --reverse -k 2 file.txt
sort -
uniq file.txt
uniq -c file.txt
whoami
hostname
hostname -f
date
date -u +%s
uptime
which node

# find without exec/execdir/prune/delete flags
find . -name "*.ts"
find . -type f -name "*.log"

# flag-specific commands
uname -a
ps aux

# compound commands where every part is individually safe
ls -la && pwd
find . -name "*.log" | grep error
cat file.txt ; wc -l file.txt
which node && ls -la
ps aux | grep node
